observations.title: HighLevel LC Phone quality safeguards can pause workflow SMS while native missed-call text-back continues
observations.claim: HighLevel's LC Phone Messaging Quality Monitoring article, modified November 10, 2026, says each sub-account is monitored for opt-out (STOP) rate and carrier-filtered message Error 30007 rate over a rolling seven-day window after at least 500 SMS. Thresholds differ for young accounts (under seven days of sending history) and mature accounts. When a restriction triggers, bulk, campaign and Workflow 'Send SMS' actions are paused; one-to-one replies in Conversations, native Missed Call Text Back (if configured), and RCS continue. The article says the improved first-restriction pause is 12 hours, with a 24-hour pause for relapse during the 72-hour monitoring period, but those improvements are rolling out only to selected sub-accounts; other accounts and newly created sub-accounts retain existing safeguards.
observations.why_now: The existing HighLevel record captured native missed-call text-back and repeat-call duplicate risk, but not the platform's message-quality restrictions. This adds a material failure mode for any SECONDS MATTER design that relies on workflow SMS after the initial acknowledgement.
observations.value: No cash or credits. This is an operational reliability and messaging-risk constraint; no quantified savings, customer recovery or revenue is established.
observations.eligibility: Applies to LC Phone sub-accounts once at least 500 SMS have been sent in a rolling seven-day window. The improved 12-hour safeguard is a phased rollout to selected sub-accounts; other sub-accounts and newly created sub-accounts retain existing safeguards. Account-specific rollout status is unknown.
observations.friction: STOP opt-outs and carrier filtering can pause bulk, campaign and Workflow Send SMS actions. Native Missed Call Text Back, one-to-one Conversations replies and RCS are documented to continue during the restriction. Manual review can keep automated sending paused until Support clears it; only an agency owner or admin can self-lift eligible temporary restrictions.
observations.observed_delta: First ledger capture of HighLevel's documented SMS-quality restriction thresholds, affected workflow actions, exceptions and phased 12-hour safeguard rollout. This is not a claim that the feature launched on the check date.
observations.anti_leverage: Do not assume every account receives the 12-hour safeguard. Do not infer that all workflow SMS remains available because native Missed Call Text Back continues during a restriction. Keep consent, business identification and opt-out handling explicit; do not treat RCS as a compliance workaround.
